faq.q: What is PTT Youngin$ in GTA 6?
faq.a: PTT Youngin$ is a gang compound in Southside Vice City, confirmed as Ultimate Edition exclusive content. Rockstar describes it as belonging to one of the area's loudest and most socially active gangs.

faq.q: Can players raid PTT Youngin$ in GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes, but only Ultimate Edition owners. Rockstar states they can exclusively raid the compound to obtain special items and distinct contraband.

faq.q: Why is PTT Youngin$ spelled differently in some articles?
faq.a: GameSpot's reporting on the Ultimate Edition rendered the name as Pit Youngin$ Illegal Goods Store, while other Rockstar-sourced promotional text renders it PTT Youngin$. The record notes the spelling varies between press sources.

faq.q: What do you get from raiding PTT Youngin$?
faq.a: The record states raiding the compound yields special items and distinct contraband, though it does not name specific rewards beyond that description.

faq.q: Where is PTT Youngin$ located in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is located in Southside Vice City, controlled by a gang Rockstar describes as one of the area's loudest and most socially active.
